On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model (which sees the context but not the question) scores **53.4 answer F1** and **50.0 support F1** on the validation set (Table 4, p. 10). On the test set it scores **53.7 answer F1** and **50.0 support F1** (Table 5, p. 10).

The model is built as an End2End Longformer-Large model given an empty question (p. 10).

The authors highlight the support score. C-only identifies supporting paragraphs well on HotpotQA (67.6 F1) and 2WikiMultihopQA (92.0 F1) without seeing the question, but this "fails on ♫-Ans" (p. 10). They credit the "positive distractors": distractor paragraphs drawn from the gold paragraphs of other single-hop questions. With distractors from full Wikipedia instead, C-only support F1 would have been 66.4 (Table 7, p. 12).
